instruction: Export all my Simple Note notes to "~/backups/notes/" directory in my file system. The files should be named according to the note title, replacing white space with "_", and the extension should be ".md".

steps.code:
simple_note_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "simple_note")
login_result = apis.simple_note.login(username='spencer.powell@gmail.com', password=simple_note_password)
print(login_result)

sn_token = login_result["access_token"]
page_index = 0
all_notes = []
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=sn_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_notes.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(all_notes))
print(all_notes)

steps.code:
fs_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "file_system")
fs_login = apis.file_system.login(username='spencer.powell@gmail.com', password=fs_password)
print(fs_login)

fs_token = fs_login["access_token"]
result = apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path='~/backups/notes', access_token=fs_token, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True)
print(result)

exported = []
for note_summary in all_notes:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_summary["note_id"], access_token=sn_token)
    filename = note["title"].replace(" ", "_") + ".md"
    file_path = "~/backups/notes/" + filename
    result = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token, content=note["content"], overwrite=True)
    exported.append((note["title"], file_path, result))
    print(file_path, "->", result)
print("Total exported:", len(exported))

files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/backups/notes', entry_type='files', recursive=False)
print(len(files))
print(files)
